answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a farm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The yarrow cap is checked at intake and delta publishes the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a juniper tag. That is 40 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
